app.name: Ivory Tower
app.tagline: An argument map for inquiry that branches
app.intro: Nobody here decides who is right. A question can hold several positions, any position can branch, and any claim can gather arguments for and against, and evidence, as deep as it needs to go. Every path stays open until the people walking it reach its end, and a dead end stays on the map as part of what we know.

app.ephemeral: Demo mode: this site has no database connected yet (DATABASE_URL), so everything written here will be lost.

bridge.title: Into rikma work
bridge.lead: When a branch reaches something that needs doing, open it as a mission or a process in one of your 1lev1 rikmas. In a rikma with several members it is a proposal, decided by that rikma's own consent rules. Nothing is decided here.
